title: Sports facilities at your college
context_es: La directora del centro donde estudias inglés quiere mejorar las instalaciones deportivas y te pide un informe.
prompt_en:
The principal of the college where you study English wants to improve the sports facilities for students. She has asked you to write a report.

In your report you should:
- describe the facilities that exist now
- explain what problems students have
- recommend two improvements

Write your report.
useful_language: The aim of this report is to …
tips_es: Un informe va por secciones con título: *Introduction*, el tema de cada parte y *Recommendations*.
Tono impersonal y objetivo: datos primero, opinión solo en las recomendaciones.
Para recomendar: *I would recommend* + -ing, *the college should* + verbo.
model_answer:
Introduction

The aim of this report is to describe the sports facilities at Riverside College, to explain the main problems that students experience and to recommend some improvements. The information is based on conversations with thirty students.

Current facilities

At present, the college has a small gym, an outdoor basketball court and two changing rooms. The gym is open from nine to five on weekdays, and all equipment is free to use.

Problems

Most students said that the gym is too crowded at lunchtime, which is the only time when many of them are free. In addition, several machines are old and two of them have been broken since January. The basketball court cannot be used in winter because it has no lights.

Recommendations

Firstly, I would recommend opening the gym until eight in the evening, so that students who have classes all day can use it. Secondly, the college should install lights on the basketball court, which would be relatively cheap. If these changes were made, far more students would do regular exercise.
